Commentary.Commentary: That's a wrap to this game. There is one final T20I left in the series and it's on Saturday, 5th March 2022 at 2.30 pm IST (9 am GMT). Do join us in advance for all the action. Cheers!

Mahmudullah, the winning captain of Bangladesh, says that it was a very pleasing performance, the way they fought with the bat and ball and the energy was great. Mentions that it was a defendable total and his bowlers did a great job. He praises Nasum Ahmed for his spell and calls it a match-changing spell. Lauds the batting effort of Liton Das as well and says that once he gets going, he is very pleasing to the eyes. Tells that he is happy for his boys, it was an important win for them and hopes to turn up and win the next game as well.

NASUM AHMED (4-0-10-4) IS THE PLAYER OF THE MATCH! The spinner says that his target was to remain economical and pick wickets in the Powerplay and is delighted to deliver. Adds that the plan was to dry up the runs, create pressure and pick up the wickets.

Mohammad Nabi, the captain of Afghanistan, says that they bowled really well on this pitch and it was a chaseable target. Adds that they threw away too many wickets in the Powerplay and were under pressure as a batting group. Hopes to come back strongly in the next match.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Bangladesh will be relieved. They have finally stopped their losing run of 8 matches with this win. The hosts ticked most of the boxes in the field but there is still a big room for improvement in their batting. Nasum Ahmed was an absolute star with the ball, claiming the first four wickets to fall, and he sucked the life out of Afghanistan's chase. The rest of the bowlers capitalized after that and it was a very meticulous and clinical show from them. This is their third-biggest win in terms of runs in T20Is.

A thumping win for Bangladesh! No one would have predicted that at the halfway mark when they managed an ordinary total on the board but the way the Bangla Tigers bowled in the Powerplay, especially Nasum Ahmed, completely took the wind out of the Afghan sails. It was a meek surrender from their batters and this defeat will hurt them badly.

OUT! TAKEN! The boundary is yet again followed by a wicket. Shoriful Islam has another one and BANGLADESH WIN BY 61 RUNS! A short one. Mujeeb pulls, it is more of the splice and Afif takes it at deep mid-wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Afif Hossain b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Finds the gap! On middle, this is whipped through mid-wicket and into the fence. Islam followed the boundary with a wicket last time, can he do the same again?

OUT! CAUGHT! Number 9 down and Islam gets his man. He sees the batter come down and bangs it short. Qais looks to pull, it goes off the top edge to the right of the pitch and Shoriful Islam takes an easy return catch. He gets his revenge.
FOUR! Beats the fielder! Shorter and outside off, this is flat-batted past the diving mid off fielder and into the fence.
Another swing but another miss! Fuller and outside off, Mujeeb looks to go downtown but does not connect.
Shorter and outside off, Mujeeb slashes but misses.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman is the new batter.

OUT! Wicket number 8 goes down! The Fizz delivers his trademark slower one, at 113.3 kph, it's a bit short and around middle and off, Azmatullah Omarzai tries to heave it over the leg side but is way too early into his shot. Ends up mistiming it high in the air at extra cover and Mahmudullah takes the catch safely at the edge of the circle.
Around middle, Qais helps it away in front of square leg for a single.
A widish yorker outside off, slower in pace, Qais digs it out back to the bowler.
Change in bowling. Mustafizur Rahman is back on. 0/17 in his 2 overs so far.
Shoriful switches to 'round the wicket and delivers it full and outside off, Azmatullah Omarzai is beaten on the drive.
SIX! Dispatched! Azmatullah Omarzai is putting up some resistance. Short and around middle, Omarzai rides the bounce and muscles it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Wide called for height! A bumper around leg, the batter tries to pull but it goes over his head.
Swing and a miss! Short and around off at 135.1 kph, Azmatullah Omarzai steps back to swing his bat at it but fails to connect.
FOUR! Slower one, a bit short and around leg, Azmatullah Omarzai opens up the on-side field, goes back and hoicks it to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Digs it in short, on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Angling away from the batter, Qais Ahmad throws his bat at it but fails to connect.

FOUR! Good shot! Too full in length and around off, Azmatullah Omarzai drills his drive past the bowler and it races down to long off for a boundary. Shakib is done with his spell, 4-0-18-2 are his figures.
The batter has just watchfully blocked this out.
Short and wide, outside off, cut to point for one.
On middle, worked on the leg side but not in the gap.
Fullish and around off, forced to sweeper cover for a run.
Full and around off, driven to covers.
Qais Ahmad is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust and the end is nigh for Afghanistan. Shoriful delivers it short and wide outside off at 137.9 kph, Rashid tries to dominate the bowler there. Sits back and slaps it over cover-point but doesn't have enough power to clear the fence. Yasir Ali takes the catch safely.
Commentary.Howout: c Yasir Ali b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: Play and a miss! Shoriful keeps his length short, around leg, Rashid walks down the track to heave it across the line but gets beaten.
Sharp bouncer, around leg, Rashid takes his eyes off the ball as he attempts to pull. Misses.
Goes short and around off, angling away, Rashid Khan rocks back to pull but misses.
A low full toss on off, bunted down to mid off for a quick run.
Fuller and around off, Azmatullah Omarzai drives it to covers.
Arm ball, around off and a bit on the shorter side, Rashid Khan punches it from the back foot to covers.
Outside off, pushed to covers for one.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, Azmatullah Omarzai tries to flick but misses.
Skidding down, it's clipped behind square leg for a run.
Fuller and on off, defended back.
Rashid Khan walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Najibullah Zadran exits the scene and that has to be the final nail in the coffin. Shakib serves this one on the pads, getting it to skid down at 86.1 kph, Najibullah turns inside the crease to work it away off his pads but gets a top edge straight up in the air towards deep square leg. Munim Shahriar, unlike the last time, takes the skier safely.
Commentary.Howout: c Munim Shahriar b Shakib Al Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Slightly short and on middle, Azmatullah Omarzai goes back and forces it down to long on for a run.
Fuller and outside off, driven square of the wicket on the off side for one. Just 4 from the over.
Floated and full around off, defended back.
Flatter and around leg, Zadran works it in front of square leg for one.
Turns it off his pads behind square leg and picks up a single.
That is defended solidly off the back foot.
Goes on the back foot and punches it down to long off for a run.
Fuller and on middle, helped on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
Debutant Azmatullah Omarzai is the new batter.

OUT! Nabi holes out! 400 wickets in white-ball cricket (ODIs and T20Is) for Shakib! Smart bowling from him. He senses the charge from Nabi and drags his length short and serves it wide outside off. The Afghan skipper has to reach out for it and he smashes it aerially over covers. His shot though lacks the desired distance and elevation and it's a simple catch for Afif Hossain in the deep. Afghanistan continue to slide.
Commentary.Howout: c Afif Hossain b Shakib Al Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Loopy and full around off, Nabi walks forward and chips it behind the bowler's head for a couple of runs.
Quicker and fuller on middle, it's worked from the back foot through mid-wicket for one.
Flat and short on middle, Nabi goes back and punches it down to long on for a run.
Fuller and around off, skidding in, Nabi defends it back from the inner half of his bat.

Drinks break. Afghanistan are in tatters at the moment. Nasum Ahmed's 4-over spell has sucked the life out of their batting and they are looking to find a way to recover. Mohammad Nabi and Najibullah Zadran are at work and let's see how they fare...
Two dots to end but the damage was done earlier on. 11 from the over. On middle, this is blocked.
Better from Rahman! Bowls it on off, cramps the batter for room, Zadran guides it to point.
More runs! Two more! Shorter and outside off, shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for two.

SIX! Over the fence! Short and outside off, Zadran stands tall and upper-cuts it, it goes more off the top edge and over the third man fielder. He slashed hard there and hence, it went all the way. Rahman has been expensive so far.
WIDE! Swing and a miss! Outside off, Zadran goes after it but misses.
Does not find the gap! There was an opportunity to get a boundary! This is short and outside off, it is cut to the point fielder who is quite close. He fumbles and a run is taken.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Change! Mustafizur Rahman is back on!
Outside off, this is cut to point. Just the 4 from Shakib's first.
A single as this is worked through square leg.
Angled into the pads, Zadran tries to whip it away but does not connect.
Another run as this is pushed through covers.
On the stumps, it is clipped through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is nudged around the corner for one.
Three dots in a row! So Afghanistan failed to capitalize after bagging a boundary on the second ball! On off, this is pushed to covers.
Shorter and outside off, Zadran slashes but misses. Another dot.
Half an appeal! Angled into middle, Zadran looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Angled into middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! Fortunate runs! Afghanistan won't mind how they come as long as they do! Outside off, Nabi looks to push it through covers but this one skids through, it goes off the outside edge down to the third man fence. Not sure why there is no slip in place, especially after the position Afghanistan are in.
Flatter and on off, this is pulled down to long on for one.
A dot to end a magical spell then from Nasum! This is on middle, it is defended. 4-0-10-4 for him.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and on off, Zadran pushes it to covers.
Pushes it through now and on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Lovely stuff! Tosses it above the eye line and lands it on off, defended.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Back of a length and on off, Nabi pushes it to covers. End of 6 brilliant overs from Bangladesh. They are well and truly on top in this game. Afghanistan are 29 for 4.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.

A loud, loud appeal but turned down! A little too high probably. This lands on off and jags back in. Nabi looks to defend, he misses and gets hit on the flap. A huge appeal but turned down. The batters sneak one as it goes on the off side. Ball Tracking shows it to be going over.
FOUR! A lot more of these needed! Shorter and outside off, Nabi cuts, it goes over point and into the fence.
Sheer timing! Shorter and on off, Zadran just puts bat on ball, gets it past the diving fielder at cover and takes three. Nabi really had to go hard for that third.
Good length and on off, Zadran defends.
Flatter and full around off, Nabi blocks it from the crease.
Fuller and around off, driven square of the wicket on the off side and the cover-point fielder stopped it with his boot.

NOT OUT! There is a spike on the UltraEdge! Nasum will have to wait for his 5-fer. A clever arm ball for the new batter, around off on a fuller length, Mohammad Nabi leans to defend but seems to have missed it. He is pinged on the front pad and the finger goes up quickly after the appeal. Mohammad Nabi immediately reviews and survives.
Given out lbw! Mohammad Nabi reviews it immediately. Is there some bat?
Mohammad Nabi walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Nasum gets his fourth and is having a ball with the ball. He is all pumped up after getting the revenge for the previous boundary! Dishes out a short delivery, around off at 91.8 kph, Karim Janat moves back inside the crease to punch it over covers but fails to get the desired elevation. A simple catch for Mahedi Hasan at covers and Afghanistan are staring down the barrel big time.
Commentary.Howout: c Mahedi Hasan b Nasum Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Bang! Flatter and fuller around middle, Karim Janat goes deep inside the crease and smacks it over mid off for a boundary.
Flighted and on off, flicked aerially through mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, on a length, punched from the back foot but straight to the cover fielder.

DROPPED! That's a tough chance. Mustafizur Rahman serves it around off, on a length and gets it to shape away with some extra bounce. Najibullah Zadran is opened up in defense and the outside edge flies behind. Liton Das dives full length to his left but fails to catch it. It deflects behind and they cross.
FOUR! Eased away!  A touch short in length, around middle and angling down, Najibullah Zadran picks it off his pads and nudges it to fine leg for a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off, it's guided down to third man for a run.
Short and around off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Fullish and around off, Janat clips it on the leg side and looks for a run. He is sent back as Mustafizur Rahman misses his shy at the striker's end.
Mustafizur Rahman is into the attack now.

Beauty! Nasum serves it from over the wicket, an arm ball around off and skidding away, Najibullah Zadran hangs back to defend but it beats the outside edge. End of an incredible over, 2 wickets and one run off it.
Fuller and around off, knocked down to long off for one.
Loopy and full around off, defended back.
Karim Janat is the new batter.

OUT! BOWLED! Afghanistan have now lost their top three batsmen with just 8 runs on the board. They are in a big spot of bother here. Nasum Ahmed delivers it full and around off, from wide of the crease, Darwish Rasooli kneels down to power it over the leg side but misses. The off stump is tickled and the crowd roars. That's inexperience for you, Darwish Rasooli could have avoided that shot.
Fuller and around off, defended back.
Najibullah Zadran arrives at number 4.

OUT! CAUGHT! Zazai departs and that dropped catch has not cost Bangladesh anything. Flighted delivery, full and around off, Hazratullah Zazai favours the leg side and attempts to heave it over mid-wicket. He though fails to middle his shot and ends up towering it towards mid off. Mohammad Naim is underneath it and makes no mistake. A big sigh of relief for Munim Shahriar who had dropped Zazai.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Naim b Nasum Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and shorter around leg, Darwish Rasooli goes back and punches it to wide long on for two.
The batter has just blocked that from his crease.

PUT DOWN! Debutant Munim Shahriar has dropped a sitter. Quicker one, full and outside off, Hazratullah Zazai throws his bat at it and gets it away off the top edge. Munim Shahriar runs back a bit at cover-point but fails to grab it. The batters cross.
Flatter and short around off, Zazai goes back and forces it towards the bowler.
Short again, outside off, Zazai cuts but finds the point fielder.
FOUR! Fine placement. Short in length and outside off, Hazratullah Zazai goes on the back foot and cuts it past the backward point fielder for a boundary.
Mahedi Hasan to bowl from the other end. A slip in place...
Fuller and flatter, around off, defended off the front foot to covers. A successful over for Nasum Ahmed.
Quicker and off, defended back.
Darwish Rasooli, the debutant, is in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Nasum Ahmed draws first blood. A terrific start for Bangladesh and the crowd is going mad. Short in length, around off and skidding in, Yasir Ali steps back to make room and power it over the infield on the off side. He though fails in his attempt and mishits it towards covers. Yasir Ali grabs a fantastic catch over his head at the edge of the circle.
Commentary.Howout: c Yasir Ali b Nasum Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Fires in a flat ball around off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz defends it off his front foot to covers.

IN THE AIR... It falls safely. Full and around off, Hazratullah Zazai tries to flick but closes the face of his bat early. It bobbles up off the leading edge but flies behind the bowler and falls safely. They cross for a run and the chase is underway for Afghanistan.
Floated and full, outside off, Hazratullah Zazai defends it to the off side.
